matches.label: exact
matches.reason: Both argue the positive GDP–contribution/price elasticity is consistent with alternative explanations such as income-elastic health demand and so does not uniquely test the internalization/exploitation mechanism.

matches.label: partial
matches.reason: Both note that population and per-capita income are not separated in the GDP specification, though A15 adds reverse causality and B11 adds other alternatives.
